name: V3 bridge-hard deterministic mechanism probe
purpose: Test whether safe identifiers discovered in a failing test can change retention of bug-relevant records in the same later repository search.

target_construction.source_state: V3 freeze with the historical production fix reversed
target_construction.search_terms: deterministically derived from predeclared safe bridge identifiers only
target_construction.term_policy: full safe test identifier plus up to three rare lexical singletons/bigrams; separator variants treated equivalently
target_construction.search_scope: Python files under headroom plus the task's changed test files

critical_record_oracle.definition: records in changed production files within five source lines of a production hunk on the reversed buggy snapshot

comparison.v3: build_search_relevance_context over user prompt plus failing pytest tool output, validated against the same target search content
comparison.primary_positive: a historical-patch-adjacent production record is DROP under baseline and KEEP under V3
comparison.secondary_positive: any production record is DROP under baseline and KEEP under V3
comparison.negative_results: retained and reported; tasks are never replaced
